extShortName.description: Short brand name. Do not translate.

extDescription.message: Find channels that stopped uploading or that you no longer watch, and unsubscribe from many at once. Runs in your browser.

localeCode.description: BCP 47 language tag of this translation, used for date and number formatting.

heroTitle.message: Clean up the channels you’ve outgrown

heroBody.message: SubSweep reads your subscriptions and watch history right here in your browser, then shows which channels have gone quiet and which ones you’ve stopped watching. You decide what goes.

feature1Body.message: All the channels you follow, with when each one last uploaded.

feature2Body.message: See which channels you haven’t watched in months.

feature3Body.message: Pick as many channels as you like and remove them in one go — with undo.

privacyNote.message: Everything stays in this browser. Nothing is sent to any server.

signedOutBody.message: SubSweep works with the YouTube account you’re signed in to in this browser. Sign in, then open SubSweep again.

lastScanned.description: {0} = relative time such as “2 hours ago”.

scanIncomplete.message: The last scan didn’t finish. Resume to continue where it stopped.

historyBackTo.description: {0} = date reached in the watch history.

watchCount.description: {0} = number of videos watched from this channel.

emptyKeptBody.message: Use the bookmark button on a channel to keep it out of suggestions.

emptyScanningBody.message: Channels will appear here as the scan finds them.

emptyNoSubsTitle.message: You aren’t subscribed to any channels.

emptyFilteredBody.message: No channels match these filters. Try a shorter time period, or look at all channels.

noticeHistoryFormat.message: SubSweep couldn’t read your watch history (YouTube may have changed its page). You can import it from Google Takeout instead.

noticeHistoryFailed.message: SubSweep couldn’t read your watch history this time. Scan again later, or import it from Google Takeout.

noticeHistoryEmpty.message: No watch history found. It may be paused for this account, so “Not watching” can’t be judged.

noticeHistoryStale.message: Watch history couldn’t be updated in the last scan, so “Last watched” may be out of date.

noticeHistoryShort.message: Your watch history only goes back to {0}, so “Not watching” is judged within that period.

noticeHistoryRescan.message: Watch history has only been read back to {0}. Scan again to read further back.

noticeUnsubPending.message: Your last bulk unsubscribe was interrupted. {0} channels are still left.

waitForScan.message: Wait for the scan to finish

confirmBody.message: SubSweep unsubscribes one channel at a time. This takes about {0}. You can switch to other tabs meanwhile — just don’t close or reload this one.

confirmUndo.message: Changed your mind? You can resubscribe from the Unsubscribed tab.

unsubRunningBody.message: You can switch to other tabs while this runs — just don’t close or reload this one. You can stop at any time.

unsubDoneWithFail.message: Unsubscribed from {0} channels. {1} couldn’t be removed — try them again later.

unsubTooManyFailures.message: Stopped after several failures in a row. YouTube may be limiting requests — try again in a while.

removedSubtitle.message: Changed your mind? Resubscribe with one click.

removedEmptyBody.message: Channels you unsubscribe from with SubSweep will appear here, so you can undo.

unsubscribedAt.description: {0} = relative time such as “3 days ago”.

setHistoryRangeHint.message: How far back to read your watch history. Longer ranges make the first scan slower.

setNoVideos.message: Count channels with no videos as not uploading

setNoVideosHint.message: Channels without any public videos will show up under “Not uploading”.

setNeverWatched.message: Count never-watched channels as not watching

setNeverWatchedHint.message: Channels that don’t appear in your watch history at all will show up under “Not watching”.

setSpeedHint.message: Fast sends many channels per request, then double-checks the result against your subscription list and redoes anything not confirmed one by one. Gentle waits longer between channels.

setLauncherHint.message: Shows a shortcut button on YouTube’s subscriptions page.

setRereadHistoryHint.message: Reads your watch history again for the whole selected range.

setRecheckUploadsHint.message: Checks every channel’s latest upload again instead of using saved results.

setTakeout.message: Import watch history from Google Takeout

setTakeoutHint.message: Optional. If reading history from YouTube fails, export “YouTube and YouTube Music → history” in JSON format and import watch-history.json here.

importFailed.message: This doesn’t look like a Takeout watch-history.json file.

setExportHint.message: Download all your subscriptions, with upload and watch dates, as a CSV file.

setClearHint.message: Deletes everything SubSweep saved in this browser. Your YouTube subscriptions are not affected.

clearBody.message: This removes saved scan results, settings and the unsubscribe list from this browser. Your YouTube account is not changed.

aboutBody.message: SubSweep runs entirely inside this browser tab. It talks only to YouTube, using the account you’re already signed in to, and keeps results only on this device. No servers, no analytics, no ads.

notAffiliated.message: Not affiliated with YouTube or Google

scanDoneNoHistory.message: Scan complete, but watch history couldn’t be read

scanPaused.message: Paused — the next scan continues from here

pauseHint.message: Pause — your progress is saved and the next scan continues from here

errSession.message: Your YouTube session has expired. Reload the page and try again.

errNetwork.message: Couldn’t reach YouTube. Check your connection and try again.

errRate.message: YouTube is limiting requests right now. Wait a few minutes and try again.

errFormat.message: YouTube’s page format seems to have changed. Please update SubSweep.
